additional_info.subject: ID0391255-DC/Si-D/DK-[yScR5A] - Converter lost and broken KF12 CRM:00315002085
additional_info.body:
Dear Markus,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R5 170002076
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
yScR5A
Problem Description
: Outlet 1 out of order and Converter missing
Troubleshooting
:
For the Outlet 1 out of order, please proceed with the replacement of the EcoG, with the error you already provided in the timeline, there is nothing we can do besides replacing. EcoG already acknowledged the issue and it's currently being declared solved in a future version of the EcoG which should only come out Q1 2025, since we cannot wait until then, the instructions are to replace it.
For the converter please do the necessary troubleshooting, what I would recommend first is to confirm if the converter is indeed faulty or not, by swapping with the one next to it and see if the error persists in the same converter.
If it persists in the same converter then we need to replace it as there is no way to confirm the error without exposing ourselves to danger.
If the error is now on the “working” converter, then we might have an issue either on the CAN cables or the AC income cables.
If you need assistance on-site please let me know with some days in advance so that I can prepare and have the time booked.
I will send this ticket to the RC-DK queue.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0391255
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
